_doc: Signals for the checkpoint/queue/returndata liveness lens. Two-signal, FP-tight: flags functions where one malicious item can block progress of a checkpoint/batch/queue, returndata is unbounded, a compaction loop can skip entries, or confirmation state is floodable. Derived from Recall H-07/H-09/M-04. Advisory; high-risk → needs_deep_pass.

recipient_blocks_checkpoint.description: An external call inside a checkpoint/batch loop lets one recipient revert or gas-bomb and block the whole batch/checkpoint.

unbounded_returndata.description: Low-level call returndata is loaded into memory without a size bound, enabling a returndata gas bomb.

compaction_skip.description: A compaction/prune loop can skip pending entries (index vs count mismatch).

floodable_state.description: Per-call append to a queue/change-log with no rate limit lets a malicious actor flood and block confirmation/progress.
